sections.body: BMI is a screening shortcut. It ignores muscle mass, bone density, and ethnicity-specific nuance. Use it for rough tracking, not diagnosis.

sections.heading: Child growth charts

faq: High muscle can push BMI up without excess fat; interpret with care.
